Subject: Post-call: token volumes & target $/1M — initial BOM attached

Hi Aisha / Samir —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put a formal estimate in front of your procurement team: 

- Scope: customer-facing assistant (clinical intake + triage) + nightly embeddings pipeline for search
- Expected q1 traffic profile you mentioned: 50k monthly active users with spikes up to 3k concurrent sessions
- Ballpark target: you said budget target in the $20k–$35k/month range, and you were curious what that maps to in $/1M tokens

Action items for your side (so our estimate is accurate):
1) Confirm expected average prompt+response token length for the assistant (you said ~350 tokens/session average?)
2) Confirm whether embeddings will be billed as 1M-vector units or per-call (we usually model at token-equivalent rates)
3) Any hard constraints on SLAs (p95 latency target, e.g., <400ms) or must-have private deployment options

Attached: olive_cost_model_v1.xlsx — very rough bill-of-materials and an initial $/1M token mapping. I used three scenarios: hosted small (gpt-like 8k context), quantized dedicated (4-bit), and dedicated GPU pool (reserved).

If you can share the token/sample export or a sample of typical messages, I can run the calc against your actual distribution and return a more precise invoice estimate.

Proposed next steps: I can send an updated estimate with a couple of pricing options by Monday if I get the token lengths and confirmation on embeddings. Also happy to lock in a 30-minute procurement sync w/ your purchasing team.

Best,

Thanks Ben — good recap. Quick answers below: 

- Avg tokens/session: 420 tokens (prompt + assistant) for clinical intake flows; triage messages are shorter at ~180 tokens. Overall weighted avg ~350 was a fair call.
- Embeddings: we'll be calling embeddings for nightly index updates; estimate ~2.4M vectors/month (this will likely increase). We typically treat those as per-embedding charges but are open to token-equivalent pricing if clearer for budgeting.
- SLAs: not strict at PoC phase — p95 <600ms is acceptable initially; we will require VPC/private deployment for PHI scope later this year.

Budget: leadership gave a target of $18k–$28k/month for the PoC stage. Happy to see your estimate.

Subject: Revised estimate + BOM (v2) and unit economics — attachments

Aisha / Samir —

Thanks for the clarifications. I ran the numbers off your distribution and attached: olive_cost_model_v2.xlsx and pricing_calculator_v3.csv. Summary below (PoC, monthly):

- Scenario A (hosted, pay-as-you-go): 
  • Assumed 50k MAU, 350 avg tokens/session, 2.4M embeddings/month
  • Estimated token consumption: ~420M tokens/month
  • Estimated cost: $33,600/month (~$80 / 1M tokens) — includes streaming overhead and embedding usage

- Scenario B (reserved dedicated, quantized 4-bit): 
  • Same token profile but using reserved GPU pool (12x A100-equivalent) with batching & prefix cache
  • Estimated cost: $22,500/month (~$53 / 1M tokens) — requires 3-month commitment; includes lower per-token inference and embedding batching

- Scenario C (hybrid: hosted + private embeddings): 
  • Hosted generation for low-latency, private dedicated for PHI-sensitive embedding index updates
  • Estimated blended cost: $26,800/month (~$64 / 1M tokens)

Notes & variables: 
- Embedding price is modelled separately; see tab 'embeddings' in the spreadsheet.
- We assumed 15% overhead for retries and bursts. If your concurrency profile is higher, token costs could increase by ~10–20%.
- Discounts: I modeled a one-time onboarding credit ($5k) and a potential volumeTiers discount at >500M tokens/month.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Confirm which scenario you'd like us to firm up (A/B/C).
2) Procurement sync to review PO template and contract terms (30 min).
3) If Scenario B or C, we'll prepare a formal reserved capacity quote and a short MOU for signature.

Can we target Tuesday 30 Nov for the procurement sync? I included a DocuSign prep link in the related links once you're ready.

Thanks — attaching the files.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: olive_cost_model_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 95KB); pricing_calculator_v3.csv (CSV, 12KB); olive_bom_breakdown.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
